claims.evidence: Witness photo shows the keyboard and a label/sticker reading “PSR-550”, but does not show it powering on or demonstrating sound.
Photo shows the control panel and keys area, but no powered-on test or key/button demonstration.
No photo shows the power adapter or accessories.
No documentation, receipt, or UK-specific markings are shown in the witness report.
No audio test or key-by-key test is shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: It may not power on, or may power on but have silent/no output issues (speaker/amp/connection faults).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the keyboard powered on with the display lit, then playing a few notes and showing volume/speaker output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed working (worst-case: needs testing/possible repair).

risks.risk: Some keys may be dead/sticking or have uneven action (common fault not visible in a still photo).
risks.proof: A video showing a full key sweep (left-to-right) with each key pressed, plus a quick demonstration of chords/scale.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible key issues (worst-case: partial dead keys).

risks.risk: Buttons/control panel may be unresponsive or have intermittent faults.
risks.proof: A video pressing multiple buttons (e.g., sound/tempo/volume controls) while the display changes accordingly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible control faults (worst-case: buttons intermittently not working).

risks.risk: Sound crackle/noise or distorted output may exist (not detectable from the photo).
risks.proof: A short audio/video recording playing sustained notes at low and high volume to check for crackle/distortion.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible audio crackle/distortion (worst-case: needs servicing).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (especially the power adapter and sustain pedal) or wrong adapter voltage.
risks.proof: Photos of the exact adapter model/label and the sustain pedal (if included), plus a clip showing it powering the unit.
risks.if_unproven: Price as missing/uncertain accessories (worst-case: buyer must source adapter/pedal).

risks.risk: Cosmetic wear/damage may indicate heavier use or impact (dust/scratches visible; internal damage possible).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the display area, keybed, and any cracks/loose parts, plus a power-on test video.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst cosmetic/unknown internal condition based on visible wear.

proof_requests: Video: power on with display lit, then play notes showing speaker output and volume control.
Video: key-by-key sweep (left-to-right) and a short chord/scale demo to confirm no dead keys.
Video: press several buttons and show the display/setting changes responding correctly.
Audio/video: sustained notes at low and high volume to check for crackle/distortion.
Photos of included accessories: power adapter (label/model) and sustain pedal (if any), plus a clip showing the adapter powering the keyboard.
response.reason: The model identification (PSR-550) is supported by the visible label, but the seller’s key working/sound/adapter claims are not verifiable from the photos. Without a powered-on and audio/key test clip, a worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
